state.contract_text: This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of twelve (12) months. Upon expiration of the initial term, this Agreement automatically renews for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party gives the other written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term. Notice may be delivered by email to the address on file or by certified mail.
state.cancellation_email_text: Hi team, we've decided not to continue with the service after our current contract year. Please treat this email as our formal notice that we will not be renewing. Let us know if you need anything else from us to process this.

is_cancellation_notice.instructions: Does `cancellation_email_text` unambiguously communicate that the customer wants to cancel or not renew the contract (as opposed to a complaint, a question, or a request unrelated to renewal)?

criteria.true: the email clearly states an intent to cancel or not renew
criteria.false: the email does not clearly state that intent

has_auto_renewal_clause.instructions: Does `contract_text` contain a clause that automatically renews the contract for another term unless the customer gives advance notice?

criteria.false: contract_text has no such clause (e.g. it expires outright, or renews only by mutual written agreement)

notice_method_valid.instructions: Does the delivery method used for the notice in `cancellation_email_text` (an email) satisfy the notice-delivery method(s) required by `contract_text`?

criteria.true: contract_text allows email notice, or does not restrict the method
criteria.false: contract_text requires a different method (e.g. certified mail only) that email does not satisfy

required_notice_days.instructions: Per `contract_text`, how many days of advance notice must be given before the end of the then-current term to prevent automatic renewal?

criteria.undeterminable: contract_text does not state a determinable notice period

days_until_renewal.instructions: As of the date in `cancellation_received_date`, how many days remain until the end of the then-current term (the next automatic-renewal date) per `contract_text`?

criteria.0_days: the renewal date has already passed or is the same day
criteria.undeterminable: the current term end date cannot be determined from contract_text and cancellation_received_date
